# Pinterest Russia

> > Russian-language Pinterest platform featuring curated visual inspiration collections across fashion, crafts, gaming, and creative design

Pinterest Russia (ru.pinterest.com) serves Russian-speaking users with diverse visual content ranging from hairstyle trends and DIY crafts to gaming character designs and digital art. The platform aggregates user-curated boards featuring popular culture references including Gacha Life, Hello Kitty, Hollow Knight, and social media aesthetics from Telegram, TikTok, and WhatsApp.

## Key Topics

- Character Design
- Gacha Life Avatars
- Bixie Haircut Styles
- Curly Hair Styling
- Amigurumi Crafts
- Hello Kitty & My Melody
- Hollow Knight Fan Art
- DIY Paper Crafts
- Profile Pictures & Avatars
- Short Hairstyles for Women
- Gaming Character Skins
- Beaded Craft Patterns
- Social Media Aesthetics
- Pixie Cut Variations
- Digital Art & Illustration
